question: What is the full form of NASA's DART mission, which successfully demonstrated the ability to alter the orbit of an asteroid for planetary defense?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Double Asteroid Redirection Test.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **New research confirms that NASA’s DART mission measurably altered the path of the asteroid system Dimorphos and Didymos.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Objective:** To test the **kinetic impactor** technique for planetary defense—hitting an asteroid to change its trajectory.
 
• **Target:** The mission impacted the moonlet **Dimorphos**, which orbits the larger asteroid **Didymos**.
 
• **Impact Date:** The intentional collision occurred in **September 2022**.
 
• **Result:** The mission not only changed Dimorphos' orbit around Didymos but also slightly altered the entire binary system's 770-day orbital period around the **Sun**.
 
• **Milestone:** This is the first time humans have intentionally changed the motion of a celestial body in space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Kinetic Impact__

 __
 
• This method involves slamming a spacecraft into an object at high speed to nudge it out of a collision course with Earth.
 
 
 
• Binary Asteroid System__
 __
 
• A system where two asteroids orbit each other. In this case, Didymos is the primary body and Dimorphos is its smaller "moonlet."
 
 
 
• Hera Mission__
 
 
• The European Space Agency (ESA) is launching a follow-up mission called **Hera** to perform a detailed post-impact survey of the DART target.
